statement: Frontend changes that do not exceed 50 lines of code may be automatically approved.
interpretation: Every changed file must be classified as frontend; a single non-frontend file requires manual review.
Lines of code = additions + deletions in the diff between the merge-base and the head (like GitHub's 'changes'), counting every line, including blank lines and comments.
Renames are not detected (--no-renames): moving a file counts as deleting + adding it.
Binary files cannot be measured and require manual review.
An empty diff is never auto-approved.
